answer: The tide register is checked at draw time, spiral lists the eligible set, and falcon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 50 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 82 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
